definitions: A keyword used in the 'rel' attribute of an HTML <a> tag, typically alongside 'noreferrer', to prevent the opened page from having a reference to the opening page via window.opener. This enhances security by mitigating phishing and tabnabbing attacks.
examples: The link included rel="noopener noreferrer" for security.
Always add noopener to external links.
The developer used noopener to protect user data.
